{{Removed|date = 26th of May 2020}} {{for|other [[Mystery (Disambiguation)|Mystery]] enemies}} {{Zombie |image1 = Uber-MysteryT.png |mode_appearance = [[Golden Mode|{{Color|GoldenMode}}]]
[[Fallen Mode|{{Color|LegacyFallenMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 32 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]120 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast |spawned_by = [[Summoner Boss]] |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Spawn}}''' - Upon its death, the '''Uber Mystery''' spawns a random enemy from the list. }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|Incoming new mysterious enemy!|Beginning of Wave 32 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Uber Mystery''' was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, having nearly the same speed as the [[Quick]], but it also had low health for its debut. However, its low health was not to be mistaken for weakness as the '''Uber Mystery''' spawned very strong enemies upon its death. Upon death it spawned either [[Molten]], [[Dark Necromancer]], [[Golden]], [[Shock]], [[Charge]], [[Slow Boss]], [[Hidden Boss]], [[Speedy Boss]], [[Abnormal Boss]], [[Shadow Boss]], [[Chained Boss]] or [[Giant Boss]]. In [[Polluted Wasteland]], it spawned the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]] instead of the [[Giant Boss]] and the [[Wasted Boss]] instead of the [[Abnormal Boss]]. The '''Uber Mystery''' used to appear in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. It was replaced by the [[Mystery Boss]]. ==Appearance== The '''Uber Mystery''' was a translucent, glossy red enemy with a glowing yellow question mark on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face and yellow glowing eyes. ==Strategy== *Like other mystery enemies, you should be prepared to deal with the enemies that spawn from an '''Uber Mystery''', with the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]] being the deadliest in [[Polluted Wasteland]] and the [[Giant Boss]] being the deadliest on any other map. **For this, the [[Minigunner]] and [[Ranger|Outlaw]] can be extremely useful. *Since the '''Uber Mystery''' itself is quite fast, and the fact that it can spawn extremely fast enemies (such as [[Shock]] and [[Charge]]), a [[Pyromancer]] is recommended to slow them down. *The [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are recommended to defeat hordes of '''Uber Mysteries''' as they normally spawn close to each other. **However, be aware that the '''Uber Mystery''' can spawn the [[Golden]], which cannot be damaged by splash damage towers. *The enemies that spawn from the '''Uber Mystery''' do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. **If you are speedrunning a map, you should focus on killing the '''Uber Mysteries''' first before moving onto the enemies that spawn. ==Trivia== *The '''Uber Mystery''' was similar to the [[Super Mystery]] as they could spawn enemies that did not normally appear in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] or [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. *The '''Uber Mystery''' was quite similar in appearance to the first version of the [[Super Mystery|Mystery 2]] which in turn, was similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Mystery2|Mystery2]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The question mark on the '''Uber Mystery''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1028826|Question Mark}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Uber Mystery''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Uber Mystery''' upon death has a chance to not disappear, instead it will have negative health and continue walking, stopping when it reaches a turn or the exit. Increases base health if it reaches the exit. *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **'''Uber Mystery''' now can spawn the [[Giant Boss]] upon its death. *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Uber Mystery''' now can spawn the [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]] instead of the [[Giant Boss]] and the [[Wasted Boss]] instead of the [[Abnormal Boss]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland]]. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **Removed, replaced with the [[Mystery Boss]]. {{Golden|[[Tank]]|Wave 30|Uber Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Boomer]]|Wave 34}} {{GoldenNuclear|[[Tank]]|Wave 30|Uber Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]]|Wave 34}} {{LegacyFallen|[[Tank]]|Wave 30|Uber Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Boomer]]|Wave 34}} {{FallenNuclear|[[Tank]]|Wave 30|Uber Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]]|Wave 34}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
